title: Adobe releases security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-263.011520: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- ADOBE RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in Illustrator CC and Experience Manager. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in Illustrator CC and Experience Manager. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TTCSIRT) encourages users and administrators to review Adobe Security Bulletins APSB20-03 and APSB20-01 and apply the necessary updates.

For further review please see the following links:

https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/illustrator/apsb20-03.html

https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/experience-manager/apsb20-01.html
